lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice asking past-tense wh-questions about yesterday.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Morning chat after one colleague was away or busy yesterday.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Asking and answering simple questions about past events.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna asks Erik what he did yesterday and where he was; Erik answers and asks one or two similar questions back.

main_focus.name: past-tense wh-questions
main_focus.description: Use question words with past-tense verbs to ask about completed actions and locations.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use past-tense wh-questions naturally 5-6 times in the dialogue.

allowed_supporting_grammar: common irregular preterite: var, kom, gick, såg

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use practical past questions that could appear in casual colleague small talk.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker asks what the other did yesterday.
dialogue_shape.middle: They ask follow-up questions about place, time, and one person or activity.
dialogue_shape.ending: They close with a short reaction to the answer.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat the past-question structure with several question words

focus: who or what the speaker saw or met
